props.name: count
props.description: Number of pendulums, 2–48.

props.name: cycle
props.description: Seconds for the pattern to go through every figure and come back to one line.

props.name: baseCycles
props.description: Swings the slowest pendulum makes per cycle; each next one makes one more. Defaults to the cycle in seconds, so the slowest swings once a second.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: Controlled release angle of the longest pendulum, in degrees. The rest are pulled back level with it.

props.name: defaultAmplitude
props.description: Uncontrolled starting release angle. Defaults to `tuning`, where the cycle closes exactly.

props.name: onAmplitudeChange
props.description: Called when the release-angle slider moves.

props.name: tuning
props.description: The release angle the strings are cut for, in degrees. Released from anything else, the row no longer returns to a perfect line. 0 is the small-angle textbook cut.

props.name: damping
props.description: Amplitude decay rate per second. 0 swings for ever; 0.01 loses about 45% of the swing in a minute.

props.name: view
props.description: Controlled view: the apparatus from the side, or the row from above, where the waves read best.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Uncontrolled starting view.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called when the view control changes.

props.name: trails
props.description: Fading after-images of the last third of a second.

props.name: sound
props.description: Offer the chime: a soft sine ping as each bob passes the bottom, at its own frequency moved up by octaves.

props.name: defaultMuted
props.description: Start muted. Sound only ever begins from a click on the sound button.

props.name: playing
props.description: Controlled swinging state.

props.name: defaultPlaying
props.description: Uncontrolled starting state.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Called when the play button, or the handle, starts or stops it.

props.name: stillPhase
props.description: Under reduced motion, the moment drawn as a still, as a fraction of the cycle. Defaults to the row forming one full wave.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Without it the drawing is decorative and hidden; the status line still announces the figures.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the transport, view, cycle ruler and release-angle controls.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins.
